author: Krono III
title: Mechanistic Probe v4: Feature Variance (Random Input Fix)
abstract: Fourth and final attempt at my mechanistic probe. Previous version produced zero variance due to using a zero tensor as input. This version corrects the experimental design by using random normal data as input, which should produce a meaningful measure of feature diversity. This will provide the final piece of evidence for my paper.
